description: Succession, assassination, coup, election, or abdication.
Formal pact, royal marriage, mutual defense treaty, or coalition forming.
Broken treaty, defection of a key officer, insider sabotage, or double-cross.
Insulted envoy, border violation, spy caught, or failed summit.
Peaceful or coerced absorption of a smaller settlement, guild, or vassal.
Ideological or religious split dividing the faction into rival sub-groups.
Peasant uprising, worker strike, mutiny, or vassal revolt.
Open battle, siege, skirmish, or raid against a rival faction.
Intelligence leak, stolen blueprints, infiltration, or counter-intelligence sweep.
Construction of walls, watchtowers, magical wards, or garrisons.
Raids on supply lines, trade caravans, or coastal shipping.
Hiring sellswords, monster-hunters, or rogue mages—or having them turn.
Windfall tax, looted treasure, profitable tariff, or debt repayment.
Bankruptcy, hyperinflation, counterfeiting scandal, or treasury theft.
Lucrative trade deal, mercenary commission, crafting order, or monopoly charter.
New mine vein found, bumper harvest, or surge in rare material output.
Famine, supply shortage, depleted mine, or blocked trade route.
Completion of roads, ports, aqueducts, or teleportation circles.
Uncovering ruins, lost technology, new territory, or an ancient artifact.
Wild magic surge, planar rift, cursed ground, or ley-line shift.
Breakthrough in alchemy, siege engineering, agriculture, or spellcraft.
Rise of a charismatic prophet, forbidden cult, or ominous omen.
Earthquake, flood, volcanic eruption, blight, or severe drought.
Magical or mundane epidemic crippling population, morale, and production.
Influx of refugees, settler expansion, or mass exodus of skilled citizens.
Festival, architectural wonder, or artistic golden age boosting influence.
Rise of a thieves' guild, smuggling ring, or widespread corruption.
Dragon awakening, undead horde, beast migration, or aberration attack.
Blessing, curse, avatar appearance, or judgment from a deity/patron.
A dormant artifact held by (or buried beneath) the faction activates with side effects.
